description: This file defines a function to copy a plugin SDK root alias file from a source to a destination, primarily used in a build or setup process. It also includes a script execution guard to run the function when the script is executed directly.

methods.name: copyPluginSdkRootAlias
methods.description: Copies the 'root-alias.cjs' file from the source directory to the distribution directory, only if the file has changed.
